digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 (overlay-priorart) and web search capability routing
propositions: T1 criterion lost web search grounding tool after Bedrock cutover because _anthropic_web_search_capabilities gated on provider-name prefix 'anthropic' which does not match 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'
web-search attachment decision must derive from model profile / capability registry membership rather than provider-name prefix matching to comply with epic zero-exceptions rule
provider_provenance.capabilities payload must record whether server-side web access was attached so silent capability withdrawal cannot recur
T1 rubric must assert web access as guaranteed rather than optional while maintaining prohibition on fabricated citations

web access is required for T1 on every configured provider including Bedrock; if native server-side tool unavailable rebar must supply it via fallback mechanism with explicit egress/caching/injection bounds
Bedrock Converse API does not support Anthropic server-side web_search natively so T1 must be served via local DuckDuckGo tool on Bedrock-routed models
